PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.

4. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

5. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

7. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.

8. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

12. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Measuring and Marking Out Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Introduction to Entrepreneurship 8  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Hardware and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Entrepreneurship 8 5.2 Production Unit 10 5.3 Financial Goals 10 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
